title: Fixed points for uniformly asymptotically Hölder-Lipschitz mappings
summary: In this work, we show that if $K$ is a nonempty, closed, bounded, and convex subset of $X$ and $1\leq γ<\sqrt{N(X)},$ where $N(X)$ denotes the Bynum normal structure coefficient, then every uniformly asymptotically Hölder $γ$-Lipschitz mapping $T\colon K\to K$ has a fixed point. To achieve this, it was necessary to guarantee the existence of a subsequence of a bounded sequence whose asymptotic diameter is controlled by the quantity $D(\{x_n\}),$ introduced by Jiménez-Melado, while simultaneously preserving the asymptotic radii at every point of the closure of the linear span generated by the…
